title: Web development with Laravel, 65 hours of training
summary: Sixty-five hours of structured training on Laravel at IIMS College, in academic collaboration with Taylor's University. It moved me from writing PHP scripts to thinking in MVC terms: routing, middleware, Eloquent relationships and REST endpoints. This is the training that the e-commerce platform came out of.

images.alt: A framed certificate being handed over at IIMS College, after completing 65 hours of web development training.
